title: Earthy Croatian Ghee Dumplings
description: Light, earthy Croatian dish featuring ghee and dumplings that are low-calorie-friendly and perfect for hangover recovery.
instructions: Mix warm water, salt, and sugar in a bowl until dissolved, then let sit for 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, combine all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, and yeast, stirring to combine.
Gradually add the dry mixture to the wet mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll into balls.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and add a small amount of melted ghee to the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the ghee to form a dumpling and press edges together to seal.
Cook the dumplings for 4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve hot with a side of steamed vegetables or soup.
